name: Microsoft Entra ID
label: Microsoft Graph v1.0 — Entra users and groups
description: Official Microsoft Graph REST v1.0 users and groups for the operator tenant (commercial default https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0). Bearer access_token (delegated or app-only, already minted). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Directory objects are personal data — minimize. Never log access_token or passwordProfile.password. add-user-to-group posts @odata.id; remove uses /$ref so the member object is not deleted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation Graph fields. Do not put access_token here.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config when non-blank. EXACT: create-user | get-user | list-users | update-user | delete-user | add-user-to-group | remove-user-from-group | create-group | get-group | list-groups | update-group | delete-group.

schema.label: userId
schema.description: Entra user object id or userPrincipalName for get/update/delete-user and group membership. Example: 87d349ed-44d7-43e1-9a83-5f2406dee5bd.

schema.label: groupId
schema.description: Entra group object id. Example: 02bd9fd6-8f93-4758-87c3-1fb73740a315.

schema.label: @odata.id
schema.description: Directory-object URL for add-user-to-group. Official: https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directoryObjects/{userId}.

schema.label: displayName
schema.description: User or group display name for create/update-user and create/update-group. Example: Ada Lovelace.

schema.label: userPrincipalName
schema.description: UPN for create-user / update-user. Example: ada@contoso.com.

schema.label: mailNickname
schema.description: Mail nickname (alias) for create-user / create-group. Example: ada.

schema.label: accountEnabled
schema.description: create-user / update-user. Whether the account can sign in. Example: true.

schema.label: passwordProfile
schema.description: create-user / update-user. Official: {"password":"…","forceChangePasswordNextSignIn":true}. Never log.

schema.label: mailEnabled
schema.description: create-group. Whether the group is mail-enabled. Security groups: false.

schema.label: securityEnabled
schema.description: create-group. Whether the group is a security group. Example: true.

schema.label: givenName
schema.description: Request-body parameter `givenName` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: surname
schema.description: Request-body parameter `surname` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: jobTitle
schema.description: Request-body parameter `jobTitle` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: department
schema.description: Request-body parameter `department` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: usageLocation
schema.description: Request-body parameter `usageLocation` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: mail
schema.description: Request-body parameter `mail` for operation: create-user.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Request-body parameter `description` for operations: create-group, update-group.

schema.label: groupTypes
schema.description: create-group. ["Unified"] for Microsoft 365 groups; omit for security groups.

schema.label: visibility
schema.description: create/update-group. EXACT: Private | Public | HiddenMembership.

schema.label: $select
schema.description: Query-string parameter `$select` for operations: get-user, list-users, get-group, list-groups.

schema.label: $top
schema.description: Query-string parameter `$top` for operations: list-users, list-groups.

schema.label: $skip
schema.description: Query-string parameter `$skip` for operations: list-users, list-groups.

schema.label: $filter
schema.description: Query-string parameter `$filter` for operations: list-users, list-groups.

schema.label: $orderby
schema.description: Query-string parameter `$orderby` for operations: list-users, list-groups.

schema.label: $count
schema.description: Query-string parameter `$count` for operations: list-users, list-groups.

ports.name: output
ports.description: 2xx: status=ok, http_status, data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed Graph JSON. Do not log directory PII or passwords.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default Graph verb when input.operation is blank.

configurationParameters.label: Graph access token
configurationParameters.description: Already-minted Microsoft Graph token (Authorization: Bearer). StudioQuack secret. Typical permissions: User.ReadWrite.All, Group.ReadWrite.All, GroupMember.ReadWrite.All (admin consent). Never on INPUT or in logs.
